name: Continuous-integration repair
description: Find the first actionable continuous-integration failure, reproduce it narrowly, and repair it without hiding flaky behavior.

outcomes.description: The failing job and first actionable error are tied to a reproducible local or isolated check.
The repair passes the focused job and relevant neighboring checks with a clear receipt.

prerequisites.description: A failed job, step, or observable warning is identified without relying on a guess.
prerequisites.check: Read the log from the first actionable error and record its stable identifier.

prerequisites.description: The failure can be reproduced without exposing credentials or modifying production state.
prerequisites.check: Compare safe runtime facts and choose the smallest reproduction command.

lanes.objective: Capture the first actionable failure, environment facts, and expected green signal.
Apply the smallest configuration, test, or environment fix that addresses the failure.
Re-run the focused failure and neighboring checks while looking for hidden flakiness.

qualityGates.description: The repair is linked to the first actionable error rather than a later cascade.
The smallest useful local or isolated check demonstrates the failure before the fix.
The focused and neighboring checks pass without deleting coverage or masking retries.

ownerConfirmationBoundaries.action: Enter a password, one-time code, passkey, or challenge response to inspect a job.
ownerConfirmationBoundaries.boundary: Stop and hand the entry to the owner; use redacted logs or an existing safe session instead.
ownerConfirmationBoundaries.reason: Authentication material is a human-only boundary.

ownerConfirmationBoundaries.action: Change billing, account security, destructive data, or live financial behavior to make CI green.
ownerConfirmationBoundaries.boundary: Stop before the action and obtain one explicit owner confirmation for that individual action.
ownerConfirmationBoundaries.reason: CI must be repaired through code or configuration, not live side effects.

rollbackRescue.rollbackPlan: Preserve the failing log summary and return to the last known-good configuration when the repair makes the signal less trustworthy.
rescueSteps: Capture the first failure and safe environment facts.
Keep the repair diff isolated and reviewable.
Record any unresolved flakiness and abandon rather than adding concealment.
stopConditions: The first failure cannot be reproduced or isolated.
The proposed fix deletes coverage or hides a retry.
A protected owner boundary is reached.

redactionRules: Omit credentials, tokens, private paths, and sensitive log payloads.
Keep safe job names and error classes only.
